minimal_state: S=(e,C) with global fixed O_E; e=[O_E,p] a primitive radial native edge and C one of the two elementary origin-star triangles incident to e, interpreted as the side into which the segment is presently sweeping
noncircularity: state uses only native vertex-edge-triangle incidence and the independently frozen signed-origin primitive adjacency; no AK tau, SEG_E, AL A8, source angle or circle membership
key_rejection: interpreting the two triangles incident to e as previous/current dual cells is invalid: the physical/native one-step segment lies along their shared primal edge rather than crossing it
